purpose: Freeze source-neutral Program 002 replacement-data requirements, compare current providers without requesting market data, select one prospective primary, and design later source-qualification and acquisition authorities.

repository_state.previous_source: Alpaca Market Data API SIP bars and quotes
repository_state.previous_source_disposition: terminally inadmissible; consumed minute-source authority; retry prohibited

bars.requirement: All thirteen frozen U.S. ETF symbols are covered for every exposed and context range; later controlled ranges remain sealed and require separate authority after their end dates.
Provide immutable five-minute OHLCV or immutable consolidated trades from which the exact frozen five-minute representation can be built without interpolation.
Regular XNYS bars use UTC bar-open labels, exact event timestamps, positive OHLC, integer nonnegative consolidated volume, and no silent force fill.
A full session has 78 bars per symbol and an early close has 42; all thirteen symbols and all six five-minute components of each required thirty-minute bucket must be present.

Price and volume adjustment semantics must be proven compatible with the frozen provider-adjusted-all-v1 treatment of splits, cash dividends, and spin-offs. No repository-inferred corporate action is allowed.
The source must expose missing intervals as absence; it must not return interpolated, forward-filled, backward-filled, or synthetic bars when no qualifying trade exists.

quotes.requirement: Historical consolidated U.S. equity NBBO supplies bid price, ask price, bid size, ask size, and event timestamps for every frozen symbol and all 73 predeclared calibration sessions.
The source supports the 657 session-clock windows and deterministic one-second sampling with a latest strictly prior quote no more than five seconds old.
Every symbol/window must yield at least 57 of 60 eligible observations. One absent or failed window fails calibration; no synthetic spread or aggregate compensation is allowed.

provenance.requirement: Bind provider, product/feed, endpoint or flat-file path, exact request, timestamps, page or file identity, retrieval time, source revision where available, and response bytes.
Persist exact raw bytes create-only, SHA-256 each page/file, canonicalize records deterministically, and fingerprint raw, normalized, adjustment, and manifest artifacts.
The contract must permit private internal research, automated retrieval, immutable local raw retention, derived bars, and reproducible internal backtests for the needed retention period.

operational.requirement: The product must be available to the user at a disclosed or contractually confirmed cost without a manual per-file workflow.
Use a provider-specific credential in a data-only process; research workers must not inherit the credential.
Pagination, retry, byte limits, staging, quarantine, and publication must fail closed and be resumable only under prospectively bound rules.

scientific.requirement: Preserve the universe, SPY role, 11:30 New York decision, 30/60-minute lookbacks, 2/4-hour holds, long/flat construction, eight configurations, chronology, gates, search budget, and controlled blocks.
Apply the frozen whole-session missing-data disposition with no symbol omission, interpolation, synthetic price, replacement date, delayed-fill workaround, or candidate exception.
Predeclare one primary and at most one fallback before any source request. A failed source may not trigger an open-ended provider search.

architecture_decision.reason: Massive is the only evaluated provider that documents both SIP-derived bars/trades and historical NBBO. A second provider would add timestamp, market-definition, provenance, and selection degrees of freedom without curing the adjustment or license gates.

primary.product: Stocks Business historical SIP-derived stock data
primary.status: prospective primary only; no subscription, source request, or acquisition authorized

technical_endpoints.corporate_actions: Massive stock splits, dividends, and ticker-event reference endpoints under a future frozen contract

architecture_decision.fallback_reason: Databento changes SIP semantics and lacks a 2020 official NBBO equivalent; Tiingo lacks documented historical consolidated quote events and durable retention. Naming either would create a non-equivalent escape hatch.
architecture_decision.provider_shopping_rule: Only Massive may receive a future source-qualification attempt under this plan. Any legal, entitlement, semantic, structural, completeness, density, or data-quality failure ends the plan. Another provider requires a new user-authorized prospective plan written without strategy results.

source_semantics.market_definition: CTA/UTP SIP-derived U.S. stock trades and official historical NBBO as documented by Massive

bars.timezone: UTC storage with America/New_York XNYS session interpretation
bars.timestamp: provider aggregate start timestamp converted exactly to UTC bar-open label
bars.session: scheduled XNYS regular session only; extended-hours records remain raw evidence and never normalize
bars.qualifying_trade_policy: Massive aggregate eligibility rules; no bar when no qualifying trade occurs
bars.adjustment_target: Exact compatibility with frozen provider-adjusted-all-v1 for splits, cash dividends, and spin-offs
bars.adjustment_gate: Before any market-data request, written provider terms or authoritative documentation must define the required factors and their price/volume application. A future implementation plan must freeze the exact formula and as-of policy. If that proof is unavailable, source qualification fails before transport.
bars.volume: provider aggregate qualifying-trade share volume, transformed only by a proven provider corporate-action volume factor
bars.missing_data: Absent aggregate means a missing required coordinate. Apply whole-session exclusion; never fill from a prior close or raw trade.

raw_trade_role.rule: Reaggregate only with a separately frozen provider condition, correction, timestamp, and bucketing specification. Compare against every provider aggregate in the bounded audit sample. Raw evidence may diagnose an omission but may not create a canonical bar.
raw_trade_role.semantic_change_warning: Aggregating all prints or combining venue feeds would change OHLCV and volume. That is prohibited under this plan.

quotes.timestamp: nanosecond SIP timestamp converted to UTC; participant timestamp retained as raw provenance
quotes.sampling: For each frozen clock, retain the five-second causal lookback and sample sixty one-second instants in [clock-30s, clock+30s). Use the latest unique SIP-timestamped quote strictly before the instant and no more than five seconds old.
quotes.eligibility: Positive bid, ask, and sizes; ask at least bid; matching symbol; otherwise retain raw and count ineligible.
quotes.coverage: At least 57 of 60 observations for every symbol/session/clock; one failed window fails calibration.

source_semantics.symbol_mapping: Use the exact frozen ticker strings. Any provider ticker event, alias, or mapping request requires a prospectively bound mapping and may not replace a universe member.
source_semantics.source_revision: Bind retrieval time, response request_id where present, next_url chain, raw byte hashes, and any provider file/version marker. Later changed bytes create correction lineage; they never overwrite.

known_mdy_gap_cross_check.purpose: Cross-provider structural completeness only; never strategy selection or performance analysis

interpretation.massive_aggregate_present: Supports a provider-specific omission or filter difference in the failed source; it does not prove the Massive dataset passes other gates.
interpretation.massive_aggregate_absent_and_no_eligible: Raises confidence that the interval had no trade eligible under the chosen aggregate definition. The session still fails Program 002 completeness.
interpretation.massive_aggregate_absent_but_eligible_ra: Treat as an aggregate construction or coverage inconsistency and fail source qualification.
interpretation.raw_trade_only_bar: Prohibited; never use it to bypass the missing-data disposition.

source_qualification_design.corporate_action_scope: Exact thirteen symbols from 2020-06-26 through 2026-07-31 for metadata/factor validation only
pre_transport_gates: signed or written plan terms permit internal non-display research, automated access, immutable raw retention, derived bars, and reproducible internal backtests
authoritative adjustment contract proves exact split, cash-dividend, spin-off, price, volume, and as-of semantics compatible with provider-adjusted-all-v1
future implementation and its exact request surface pass independent review
future one-use authority and independent authority review bind the implementation commit, exact samples, credential identity hash, limits, and all-false strategy authorities

request_chain_budget.rule: The future authority must allow only these exact provider, endpoint, symbol, and time-range chains. Retries stay inside a chain; no spare chain may query another coordinate.

pass_criteria: all 8,658 expected aggregate rows exist at the exact XNYS UTC bar-open coordinates
all nine known MDY coordinates exist as provider aggregates
all full controls have 78 bars per symbol and the early close has 42 per symbol
every audited nonempty raw-trade bucket exactly matches provider aggregate OHLCV under the frozen provider eligibility contract
no audited provider aggregate omits a bucket containing a provider-eligible raw trade
every one of 468 quote symbol-windows has at least 57 of 60 eligible observations
aggregate, raw trade, quote, and corporate-action timestamps and symbol mappings match the frozen semantics
all corporate-action records and factors needed by the sample are complete and deterministic
every response page, request identity, adjustment record, normalized sample, and receipt is hashed and reproducible
source_qualification_design.failure_action: Exhaust the one-use authority, retain bounded raw evidence and a terminal failure receipt, publish no qualification pass, perform no full acquisition, and do not try another provider.
source_qualification_design.receipt_contract: A pass receipt contains structural counts, exact coordinates, quote coverage, semantic checks, raw hashes, cost bytes, and no prices except immutable source evidence. It contains no candidate fill, P&L, return, rank, strategy gate, or qualification result.

proposed_acquisition_architecture.adapter_boundary: A Massive-specific read-only adapter behind the existing dataset/acquisition storage boundary. It imports no strategy, PAPER, order, broker, or live module.

proposed_commands.source_qualification: uv run trading-lab program-002 source qualify-massive --authority <reviewed-one-use-authority>
proposed_commands.full_exposed_acquisition: uv run trading-lab program-002 source acquire-massive-exposed --authority <reviewed-full-acquisition-authority>

credential.reason: Massive is a data vendor and the selected key has no broker-order authority. A dedicated Program 002 key under the licensed account and process isolation are sufficient.

proposed_acquisition_architecture.raw_storage: Create-only exact response bytes per request/page, non-secret request metadata, response request_id, next_url chain, retrieval time, and SHA-256. Corporate-action records and trade-condition specifications are separate immutable source inputs.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.normalization: Parse exact decimal prices and integer volumes, apply only the separately reviewed provider factor contract, convert to UTC bar-open labels, filter to expected XNYS coordinates, and preserve all filtered records in raw evidence.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.manifests: Bind provider, product, business entitlement, endpoint, request range, symbol, adjustment contract and snapshot, condition rules, timestamp policy, calendar, raw hashes, normalized fingerprint, parent correction lineage, qualification receipt, and authority identities.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.pagination: Follow next_url exactly until absent. Reject origin, path, query-scope, cursor-cycle, page-limit, schema, or ordering drift. Never silently truncate.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.retry: Retry only prospectively listed transient transport statuses within a fixed per-page attempt ceiling. Semantic, entitlement, completeness, pagination, or validation failures are terminal and cannot trigger provider substitution.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.completeness_admission: Run the existing frozen Program 002 whole-session and quote-window admission boundary before any strategy authority can bind the dataset.
proposed_acquisition_architecture.publication: Stage privately, fsync, validate, create-only publish content-addressed raw and normalized artifacts, then obtain independent exact-byte review before later use.

full_acquisition_authority_design.provider_binding: Massive Stocks Business SIP-derived aggregates and historical NBBO under the exact reviewed contract
full_acquisition_authority_design.quote_grid: The exact frozen 73 sessions by nine clocks by thirteen symbols

exact exposed/context ranges and expected XNYS coordinate tables

immutable local raw and normalized retention after subscription ends for audit and reproducibility
deterministic derived five- and thirty-minute bars and adjustment artifacts
internal hashes, manifests, reports, and backups
no public redistribution of raw market data

no sample or full market-data download

next_authorization: After a finding-free independent review and clean merge, the next possible user authorization is ONE-USE SOURCE QUALIFICATION ONLY for the exact Massive sample and controls in this plan. It must not authorize full acquisition or strategy execution.
